description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Appointed Mr. R. S. Ariyapperuma, Mr. T. Piyasoma, Mr. Sarath Liyanage and Mr. T. E. Santharajan as the Arbitrators to arbitrate the Industrial Disputes between Mrs. U. S. M. Piushani and (1) Ceylinco Capital Investment Company (Pvt.) Limited, (2) Ceylinco Sri Ram Capital Management Services Company (Pvt) Limited; between Inter Company Employee's Union and Serendib Leisure Management Limited; between Mr. R. Anurudda Maweli and Sri Lanka Transport Board and between Mrs. B. Vishaka Ranatunga and Employee's Trust Fund Board respectively
